comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A red-name Ganador, he can be challenged when the World Clock is set to the 16th Century's fourth or fifth periods, or if one equips Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.4) / Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.5) titles or Age effect (16th century) EX Effect equipment. Additionally, you must have also defeated Francis Drake once.

Can potentially drop Peascod-bellied Doublet when defeated.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/List
